requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF personal_or_group_survival_equipment_required = true, THEN available_survival_equipment_capacity >= ceil(persons_on_board * 1.10) AND storage_accessibility_status = accessible.
requirement.requiredInputs: Persons-on-board count, equipment capacity, and storage-location evidence
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: When required, personal and group survival equipment sufficient for 110% of the persons on board shall be stowed in easily accessible locations, as close as practical to the muster or embarkation stations.
